title: Reorganize String
description:
Given a string s, rearrange the characters of s so that any two adjacent characters are not the same.
Return the lexicographically smallest valid rearrangement of s, or the empty string if no valid rearrangement exists.
 
## Examples

### Example 1:
```text
Input: s = "aab"
Output: "aba"
```
### Example 2:
```text
Input: s = "aaab"
Output: ""
```

## Constraints

- 1 <= s.length <= 500
- s consists of lowercase English letters.
